Agentivity handles work that has several steps and needs judgement on the way: reading, comparing, writing, checking, and asking a person when a decision is theirs. This page shows what that looks like.

## Four examples you can open

Agentivity offers four showcase solutions. You import one in a few clicks and you see how it is built. See [Try a ready-made solution](/docs/getting-started/try-a-ready-made-solution/).

| Showcase | The need | How it is built |
|---|---|---|
| **Invoice Clerk** | Read the supplier invoices you upload, file each one and check its figures. | One agent and one data table. |
| **CV Screening** | Compare a CV with a job description and propose what to do with it. | One workflow. |
| **Shopping Lab** | Compare a product across stores and write a recommendation. | One team of nine agents that work one after another, and five data tables. |
| **Trip Manager Team** | Plan a full trip: flight, hotel, car, dining, transport. The bookings are simulated. | One team of thirteen agents led by a manager, and two data tables. |

The four examples use the three building blocks: one agent, one workflow, two teams.

## The kinds of work it suits

- **Reading and filing.** Read documents, take out the facts, check them, store them in a table.
- **Preparing and writing.** Gather information, write a note, a reply or a report, and have another specialist review it.
- **Comparing and recommending.** Look at several options against your criteria and say which one fits.
- **Handling a request from start to finish.** Understand what a person asks, send each part to the right specialist, and come back with a complete answer.
- **Work that needs your approval.** Do everything up to the decision, then stop and wait for a person.

## Start small, then grow

You do not need a large project to begin.

1. **One agent** that takes one repetitive job off your hands.
2. **One team**, when the job needs several skills, or when one specialist should check the work of another.
3. **A workflow**, when the steps must be the same every time and a person must approve before the work continues.
4. **Teams that use other teams.** A member of a team can be another team or a workflow.

## What it does not do today

- **It does not start by itself.** An execution starts when a person starts it in the Studio, or when an application asks for it. Starting executions on a schedule is planned, and it is not available yet.
- **It has no login.** Agentivity does not know who is using it. Anyone who can reach your server can use everything on it. Keep it on a network you trust.
- **It does not provide the AI model.** You connect your own.
